title: Portrait photograph of Richard M. Bissell, Jr., Chapter 1 p. 16
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a man wearing glasses, suit, and tie, captioned "Richard M. Bissell, Jr." Accompanying text covers Bissell joining the Agency in 1954, the Guatemala operation, and DCI Allen Dulles's attitude toward a Kapustin Yar overflight proposal.
